status: EC address42/channel1 candidate mapped; peripheral and USB4 signal ownership remain unverified

shared_transfer.payload: One register selector followed by one data byte. Preparation fills the shared TX/RX descriptors and sets R3=2, R2=0, R5=42, R7=1.
shared_transfer.return_handling: Callers treat returned R7 nonzero as success; zero takes failure handling. This is firmware transport status, not independently measured device acceptance.

steady_writer.rule: Skip equal desired/last-written values. Write changed values with the shared transfer. Update the corresponding last-written byte only on nonzero return.

groups.operation: Set desired A/B/C to19/01/01 and additional cached bytes to zero, then advance.

groups.data: three additional cached bytes, initially zero

initialisation.progression: The invocation clears a shared failure count. Each group records failed transfers and advances the stage only when that count remains zero. Successful groups may fall through within the same invocation. A failed group retains its stage for a later invocation; no real-time interval is assigned.
initialisation.after_groups: The changed-value writer is available once stage>=6.

upstream_bit_helpers.scope: Reviewed helpers set/clear individual bits in one of the three desired bytes and branch/call the changed-value writer. Some also change a separate local flag.
upstream_bit_helpers.signal_names_and_board_connections: Unidentified. These are GPIO-like operations by structure, not a qualified chip identity or USB4 mode-register definition.

code.scope: Original code facts and exact byte/span assertions only. No runtime execution, peripheral simulation, target read, live flash hash, bus measurement or physical timing qualification in this interval.

assessment.supported: This candidate is a staged peripheral configuration and three-byte cached control-image write path; it is not a captured retimer status read.
unproven: Identity of the peripheral at EC channel1/address-byte42
Whether this bus/address is the same physical target as any ACPI PS8830 endpoint
Meaning of its register selectors and individual control bits
Whether a reviewed bit drives USB4 routing, power, reset or something unrelated
Execution and returned status during the failed ASUS-DEG2 connection
assessment.disposition: Defer this candidate as a PS8830-specific intervention until target/signal ownership can be tied to original code or board evidence. Do not reject all possible indirect USB4 effects.
assessment.next_task: Follow the existing bank3 CPUc720 channel4/address98 candidate with exact caller/payload/status handling. Compare with already recovered UCSI relay to identify any genuinely separate private PD/mode operation; if it is the same relay preparation, record that and do not rediscover it.

analysis_quality.candidate_b5d4_is_valid_shared_entry: Callers deliberately enter at b5d4 after preparing the command and data; it is not necessarily a standalone function prologue.
analysis_quality.preserved_attempts: Initial broad range began between instructions; only reviewed shared entries/call boundaries support the result. A second range also began mid-instruction and one range ended with a truncated instruction; neither fragment is used as evidence. All original outputs remain private.
